verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud browser platform with SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The observability features (logs, live view, session replay) are user-facing session monitoring, not a telemetry control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
